stem: A flowering plant has localized gray sporulating tissue after prolonged high humidity. Which response best fits integrated disease reasoning?
choices: Record the sign and environment, contain/handle the affected material under procedure, and confirm/disposition according to the facility disease workflow.
Assume every nearby flower is infected without scouting.
Ignore humidity because only the pathogen matters.
rationale: Visible gray mold-like growth plus favorable environment can strongly support a Botrytis workup, but scope, handling and treatment/disposition remain controlled.
